versions.changelog:
- Added support for switching the OpenViking embedding model to a local llama-server or any OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint managed within a bwrap sandbox via job-env-manager.
- Automatically detects current configuration, validates the target endpoint, modifies ov.conf, deletes incompatible vectordb index when dimension changes, and safely restarts openviking-server within the sandbox.
- Verifies health, PID, and embedding dimension after the switch, with automatic rollback on failure.
- No access to Huawei Cloud services required; operates entirely via local REST API to job-env-manager.
- Includes robust validation, backup, error handling, and log checks to prevent common pitfalls and ensure seamless migration.
